summary: Full e2e testing of Quantum AI Step 2 (app shell + chat workspace + conversations persistence). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests for /api/conversations CRUD pass (create/list/get/patch/delete/delete-all/user-isolation) plus /api/auth/me. Frontend: all critical flows verified end-to-end — login test1@example.com transitions from /auth to app-shell at / (no navigation bug reproduced), welcome screen + 6 task cards render, image task card toggles image mode indicator, sending a message creates a conversation, shows the user message and an honest 'ChatGPT/Image Generation isn't connected yet' assistant container (not a fake response), auto-title from first message, conversation appears in sidebar, persists after page reload with messages intact when selected. Sidebar search filters ('Sidebar' -> 1, 'nomatch' -> 0), rename & delete via actions menu work with confirm dialog, TODAY grouping header shown. Model selector lists chatgpt/gemini/claude/perplexity/image (Not connected) and quantum (aria-disabled=true, Coming soon). Profile menu shows display name, email, Registered account badge, Settings item nav to /settings works, all 7 settings sections present. Composer: Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts newline (value='line1\nline2'), attach button shows info toast 'Attachments arrive in a later step'. Guest login works (previous iteration_1 bug is fixed), guest badge + amber sidebar notice + chat interface all functional. Mobile 390x844: sidebar hidden by default, mobile-menu-button present, no console errors.

issues: Sonner toast (top-center) can intercept pointer events over the mobile-menu-button when a toast is visible. Not a blocker (toasts auto-dismiss) but consider moving toasts below the topbar on mobile or reducing z-index so header controls remain clickable during toast.

action_items: Optional/minor: adjust Sonner toast z-index or position on mobile so it does not overlap the mobile-menu-button while visible.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatContext.sendMessage relies on activeId/messages from closure but they aren't in the useCallback deps in a way that reflects the newly created conv id — currently works because subsequent messages naturally send with activeId set; low risk.
conversations.messages persisted with a cap of last 200 (server.py line 384) — good, but no client-side warning if truncated.
server.py CORS allow_origins is empty if CORS_ORIGINS env is missing; ensure the env var is set for the preview URL (currently working).
test_credentials: test1@example.com / Testpass123 (verified). Guest via /api/auth/guest (verified). Admin verified in iteration_1.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed conversations/messages created during pytest run; cleaned up by the tests themselves. Some guest users left in db (expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Step 2 is fully functional: app shell, sidebar CRUD, conversations persistence, settings page, guest & registered flows, model selector, composer behaviors, mobile responsive layout. The iteration_1 guest-login DuplicateKey bug is fixed (partialFilterExpression on users.email). Next iteration can focus on real AI provider integrations (Step 3) — the queryProvider abstraction is at /app/frontend/src/providers/aiProviders.js and throws PROVIDER_NOT_CONNECTED which the UI handles gracefully.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found in this iteration. The suspected 'login does not navigate to /' bug from the review request could NOT be reproduced — login for test1@example.com consistently transitioned to app-shell at / within 8s (see playwright output URL=https://quantum-auth-5.preview.emergentagent.com/ and app-shell selector visible).
